Controls

Rudder: joystick (left/right) or ← → / A D — release to return to midships  ·  Telegraph: W / S or ↑ ↓, click the panel, or keys 1–8  ·  Command: Tab or the fleet panel  ·  Fleet mode: INDV drives only the selected ship (the rest hold their last orders) · FLEET drives the selected ship as flagship, the fleet follows · ANCHOR holds the selected ship, you drive all the other ships  ·  Pause: P
Drag / swipe the sea: orbit the camera round the fleet  ·  Wheel / pinch / + / -: zoom  ·  Shift + drag: pan the camera  ·  Right-drag: free look  ·  ↺ (or R) resets the camera  ·  U: dive below the surface  ·  Click a sinking ship's row to watch her go down  ·  Air Ops: the panel launches flights  ·  C: follow a jet / weapon  ·  N: radar north-up / heading-up  ·  Esc: back to the fleet
